programme.title: Andromeda: Double Helix
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver involveret i en fejde mellem en Than-planet og en nietzscheansk koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon
programme.desc: En slipstream sender Andromeda tilbage i tiden til lige før Commonwealths fald. Besætningen må gribe ind for at bevare historien.
programme.sub-title: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon

programme.title: Andromeda: Båndene der blinder
programme.desc: Besætningen besvarer et nødopkald og samler Beckas bror, som nu er Wayist, og hans ven op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lethe-bankerne
programme.desc: Et sort hul giver Dylan mulighed for at kommunikere med sin tidligere forlovede 300 år tilbage i tiden.

programme.title: Andromeda: En rose i asken
programme.desc: Dylan er fængslet på en fængselsplanet og må arrangere en flugt, mens hans besætning forsøger at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hele Neptuns store hav
programme.desc: Castalianere går om bord på Andromeda for at færdiggøre charteret for det nye Commonwealth. Da lederen bliver fundet død, er Tyr den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Perlerne, der var hans øjne
programme.desc: Beka finder ud af, at hendes fars tidligere forretningspartner handler med et stærkt vanedannende stof kaldet F lash

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårernes matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda opdager sit søsterskib, Pax Magellanic. Besætningen om bord på Pax er 300 år gammel... men er ikke blevet ældre en eneste dag.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik fra en fjern tromme
programme.desc: Tyr nødlander Eureka Maru på en nietzscheansk planet og får hukommelsestab. Han skal huske, hvad han laver, før nietzscheanerne opdager ham og hans kasse med stjålne varer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper modtager viden fra en døende Perseid, men opdager først, at Perseid blev eftersøgt af en dusørjæger, som nu har rettet sin opmærksomhed mod Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvunget perspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan bliver arresteret for at have myrdet en diktator for 300 år siden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summen af dens dele
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver bordet af en drone fra Consensus of Parts, et mytisk mekanisk samfund. Ibegyndelsen er dronen venlig, men den forsøger at tvinge skibet til at slutte sig til Consensus.

programme.title: Andromeda: Frygt og afsky i Mælkevejen
programme.desc: Gerentex er tilbage, og han kræver, at Trance og Harper hjælper ham med sin nye plan: at finde Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Djævelen tager det længste strå
programme.desc: Dylan og Rev Bem hjælper et fredeligt samfund med at stå op mod deres potentielle slavehandlere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Honningtilbuddet
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at skabe fred mellem to forskellige nietzscheanske stoltheder ved at eskortere prinsessen fra det ene sted til hendes arrangerede ægteskab med prinsen fra det andet sted.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stjernekrydsede
programme.desc: Rommies avatar bliver forelsket i det, der viser sig at være avataren af et krigsskib ved navn Gabriel. Gabriel forsøger at inficere Rommie med en virus, der sender sine planer til krigsskibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det er et dejligt lys
programme.desc: Beka tager Andromeda med til Tarn-Vedra, men længere tid i slipstrømmen giver bivirkninger. For at bekæmpe dem begynder Beka at tage Flash og bliver snart afhængig.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endelig er tiden kommet
programme.desc: En gammel erindring fra Andromeda aktiveres ved et uheld, hvilket sender hende på en mission og efterlader Dylan og besætningen ude af stand til at tilsidesætte kommandoen

programme.title: Andromeda: Det voksende kredsløb
programme.desc: Dylan og Rommie skal redde Tyr, Harper og Rev fra et Magog-verdenskib.

programme.title: Andromeda: Exitstrategier
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev og Tyr styrter ned efter at være undsluppet en bande nietzscheanere, men står snart over for en ny trussel: Rev's behov for at spise.

programme.title: Andromeda: Et hjerte for falskhed indrammet
programme.desc: Besætningen skal stjæle en juvel, som er centrum for en fejde mellem en driftsejer og Than. Beka falder for en sikkerhedschef, som tidligere var tyv.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside — physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: High 'n Dry
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science give investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: To the Viktor
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wired for Disaster
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Going for Broke
programme.desc: When a successful stockbroker doesn't return home after a late shift, his wife reports him missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Just Desserts
programme.desc: The prime suspect had a criminal record and his driver's license was found at the scene of a brutal double homicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday's Wake
programme.desc: When a little girl got sick and died, investigators were stumped. Was it an accident, an unexplained illness or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dockter Visit
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of a World War II veteran slowed to a halt when the prime suspect had a solid alibi. But a lucky break led to a shady character who wore distinctive boots and had a sweet tooth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Concrete Alibi
programme.desc: An aspiring model turned up dead and the prime suspect was her boyfriend. When he was eventually cleared, investigators had to dig deeper to find the perpetrator. With the help of a forensic geologist, they identified the most unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Key Evidence
programme.desc: When an off-duty policeman was shot dead, his fellow officers were determined to solve the crime. They needed clues to find the killer and they discovered them in tiny fibres and an asthma inhaler.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Weakest Link
programme.desc: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Capitol Crimes
programme.desc: The driver said he couldn't have hit and killed a pedestrian on a Harrisburg street. The Jeep Grand Cherokee he was leasing around that time had been sold months ago to a buyer in another state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Undertaken
programme.desc: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dark Waters
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nice Threads
programme.desc: A woman was found dead on the bedroom floor of her apartment. The crime scene yielded little of value and investigators wondered if they would find enough evidence to make a case, much less catch a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grave Danger
programme.desc: A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened and the truth devastated three families.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue
programme.desc: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Safe Place
programme.desc: A wealthy man and his wife were attacked by three masked men outside their luxurious Louisiana home. He was shot dead and she was forced to open their hidden safe. To solve the crime, police would have to find out who knew about the concealed safe.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Live Wire
programme.desc: A bomb, constructed to cause as much damage as possible, kills a victim with deadly force and flame. When a painstaking search yields some tiny clues, police are able to identify the killer as surely as if he'd signed them.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.desc: When life gives you lemons - make lemonade. When life gets you down - get back up. When life gives you dead flat seas, 40 degree heat, a sounder lit up like a Christmas tree and 1 hour left of fishing - make great TV!

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.sub-title: I Want You To Want Me

programme.title: Are You The One?: Master Plan
programme.desc: Brias besættelse af Zak truer husets evne til at spille spillet. Cali finder på en plan, der skal afsløre, hvilke magtpar, der er perfekte sammen, og hvem der ikke er.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time
programme.desc: Til en vild fest gør tvivlsom opførsel bedste venner til fjender. Tevin og Kenya gør sig klar til at få opklaret deres skæbne. Moe bliver presset til at tage sig sammen.
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time

programme.title: Are You The One?: Caught On Kiss Cam
programme.desc: Kwasi og Jasmines forhold bliver bragt i fare, når en velkendt fjende komme lidt for tæt på. Magtpar prøver at skabe nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This is Nuts-a
programme.desc: Brett kommer i den varme stol, da han tvivler på sine følelser for Nutsa. Huset kommer i krise, da de prøver at hitte ud af de perfekte par.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It All Comes Down To This
programme.desc: Asia forsøger at ødelægge Sams forhold til Daniel. Huset får en sidste chance for at vinde kærlighed og penge og en ekstra dag til at bringe orden i tingene.
programme.sub-title: It All Comes Down To This

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: An Ideal Home
programme.desc: Kendiskokken Erasmus og hans partner Paul småskændes konstant, men deres succesfulde TV-show holder dem sammen. Deres tilværelse bliver vendt på hovedet, da Erasmus en dag bliver konfronteret af det barnebarn, han ikke vidste, han havde.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Efter Cady har boet i Afrika, aner hun intet om, hvor 'vilde' ting kan blive i civilisationen, indtil hun møder den ondeste art 'Queen Bee', der på denne skole er den kølige og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
programme.desc: 30-årige Eric og en gruppe gamle high school-venner holder hver sommer vilde fester i hans forældres strandhus. Da hans far planlægger at sælge huset, må Eric indse, at det er tid til at blive voksen. Der skal dog lige afholdes én sidste fest.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: Barndomsvennerne Steve og Ben rejser tilbage til deres hjemby, da Ben får at vide, at han har arvet en sum penge fra sin far. Men pludselig befinder de sig i et juridisk slagsmål med Bens søster og farens unge enke, da arven er større end forventet.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Joel and Molly fall in and out of love in this hilarious spoof on a romantic comedy from the director of WET HOT AMERICAN SUMMER and ROLE MODELS.

programme.title: The Final Cut
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Mira Sorvino og Jim Caviezel leverer dynamiske præstationer i denne fantastiske thriller om de mørke sider af futuristisk teknologi.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's A Madea Christmas
programme.desc: En kvinde tager sin veninde med på et overraskende besøg hos sin datter på landet. Turen viser sig dog at være alt andet end fredelig med lokalbefolkningen, der skændes og afslører hinandens hemmeligheder.

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: Three hapless guys are mistaken for Army Reservists and loaded onto an army plane headed for Iraq and then mistakenly ejected in a Humvee somewhere over Mexico.

programme.title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: For three showgirls it was the dream of a lifetime, a four week cabaret engagement in Alice Springs. The problem is simply getting there intact, along with their bus Priscilla. It's not easy being a drag queen in the outback!

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman og den Oscar® vindende Rachel Weiszspinder instruktøren Darren Aronofsky en tidløs fabel om en mands søgen efter Livets Træ.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Secret Service agenten Pete Garrison kommer påsporet af en forræder i Det hvide Hus, men bliver selvmistænkt og må bevise sin uskyld - inden det er forsent.

programme.title: The Hunter
programme.desc: Steve McQueens sidste film understreger den storslåede skuespillers dynamiske talent i en af hans mest mindeværdige roller, som den moderne dusørjæger Ralph "Papa" Thorson.

programme.title: Black Eagle
programme.desc: Et af det amerikanske flyvevåbens mest moderne fly, et F-111 med et helt nyt laserstyresystem, styrter ned i hav ud for Malta. Sovjetisk tilstedeværelse i området gør, at CIA sender deres bedste agent for at bjærge styresystemet.

programme.title: Slow West
programme.desc: En ung skotte rejser gennem det vilde vesten for at finde sin tabte kærlighed. Han allierer sig med en mystisk fremmed på en farefuld færd.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: Mike Riggins er en eksmarinesoldat, som sidder fængslet i et af verdens mest barske fængsler. Men en dag får han besøg af en mand fra den amerikanske ambassade, der tilbyder ham hans frihed samt en sum penge for at befri en amerikansk kvinde.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: Bare Juliet
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er kørt træt i sit parforhold med Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), der er kæmpefan af musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Da en demoversion af Tuckers gamle hit LP dukker op, bliver det starten på et nyt møde med den flyvske kunstner.

programme.title: Madness In the Method
programme.desc: I håb om at komme væk fra kun at være kendt som ”Jay fra Jay og Silent Bob” vil Jason Mewes sammen med instruktør Kevin Smith opspore en bog, som skal hjælpe ham med at blive en seriøs og respekteret skuespiller.

programme.title: The Bay of Silence
programme.desc: Will (Claes Bang) er overbevist om, at hans kone, Rosalind, (Olga Kurylenko) ikke har noget at gøre med det formodede mord på deres søn, men opdager den frygtelige sandhed bag hendes tilknytning til en anden uopklaret forbrydelse i hendes fortid.

programme.title: Modern Persuasion
programme.desc: En singlekvinde med fokus på karrieren i New York bliver tvunget til at forholde sig til følgerne af et forlist forhold, da hendes ekskæreste hyrer hendes firma. En moderne udgave af Jane Austens roman ”Kærlighed og svaghed”.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
programme.desc: To ensomme sjæle finder kærlighed og en forbindelse midt i storbyens kaos. En hjertevarm fortælling om kunst, skæve eksistenser og humor.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Nogen er gået for vidt med din kærlighed til efterfølgere! Favoritfigurerne fra SCARY MOVIE er tilbage i en film, der skræmmer til mere uærbødig morskab end originalen med sin version af kliche-spøgelsesfilm.

programme.title: Med Røven I Vandskorpen
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller hovedrollen som Tripper Harrison, lejrchefen på Camp North Star. Der er masser af sjov og ballade i vente, mens han sammen med lejrens øvrige ledere gør, hvad han kan for at bryde alle regler.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Da en klog sort hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles bliver transporteret tilbage til middelalderens England, leder han omstyrtelsen af en ond konge og vinder en protofeministisk kvindes hjerte.

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Hvad kan være mærkeligere end det hul, der opstår i Lucy Sherringtons stuegulv? Svaret viser sig at være kærlighed.

programme.title: Tully
programme.desc: 'Tully' er skrevet og instrueret af skaberne af den højtelskede Oscar-vinder 'Juno'. Skrevet af Diablo Cody (Young Adult) og instrueret af Jason Reitman (Thank You for Smoking, Up in the Air og Young Adult).

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Doctor's Daughter
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: On the Case: Snake in the Grass
programme.desc: A cloud of smoke leads two truckers to a shocking discovery; the smoldering remains of a teenage girl.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer in Disguise
programme.desc: Police race to track down the unlikely killer responsible for three terrifying murders.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 202 - Military / Internet ID Theft
programme.desc: In this story, veterans of Iraq and Afghanistan tell how their identities were stolen, destroying their families while they were away serving their country.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: On the Case: A Father's Quest
programme.desc: After finding his beautiful 19 year old daughter dead, a father launches a relentless pursuit of her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: On the Case: The East Area Rapist
programme.desc: A sexual sadist known as the East Area Rapist terrorizes California and its law enforcement officers for decades.

programme.title: On the Case: Unfinished Journey
programme.desc: Jamie Bowie disappears while driving from Phoenix to Los Angeles on Interstate 10, then her body is found near the highway a month later.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A church-going New England wife and mother of three is accused of the brutal slaying of her husband, a highly respected doctor in Maine.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files: Surjit Athwal
programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre interviews former Detective Chief Inspector Clive Driscoll to discover how he investigated the suspected murder of Surjit Athwal, without a body or witness.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: On the Case: A Nightmare in Memphis
programme.desc: In Memphis, Tennessee, a young mother's mysterious disappearance launches one of the city's most noteworthy criminal investigations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: On the Case: Evil Repeats Itself
programme.desc: Beautiful teenager Mary Jayne Jones is found murdered in a desolate farmhouse while its owner is out of town.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder At Sunset- Part 2
programme.desc: A mother and two daughters are discovered floating in Tampa Bay after a brutal triple homicide. Police must rely on a victim who survived a similar attack to bring the killer to justice in this special two-hour On the Case.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files: Gangland Hit
programme.desc: Detective Superintendent Andy Tattersall explains how Greater Manchester Police solved the case of Andrew Green's murder at the hands of a ruthless gangsters.

programme.title: Corporate: Labor Day
programme.desc: Matt og Jake laver ballade, da de arbejder på Labor Day, indtil de opdager, at de ikke er de eneste på kontoret.

programme.title: South Park: 1%
programme.desc: De 99% rotter sig sammen mod Eric Cartman.

programme.title: Corporate: The Tragedy
programme.desc: Da en national tragedie indtræffer, dyster alle på kontoret om at have det mest skærende og medfølende indlæg på de sociale medier.

programme.title: South Park: To nøgne fyre i en jacuzzi (del 2)
programme.desc: Da drengene laver et telefonsjov-opkald til politiet, omringer de huset, fuldt bevæbnet, hvilket bringer minder frem om Waco.
programme.sub-title: To nøgne fyre i en jacuzzi (del 2)

programme.title: Corporate: F**k You Money
programme.desc: På en forretningsrejse nyder Jake hotellets goder, Matt ser sin frygt i øjnene, og de lærer begge noget af en anden rejsende.

programme.title: Broad City: Sleep No More
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana besøger 'Sleep No More' og Abbi vil finde det rigtige tidspunkt til at fortælle Ilana en livsforandrende nyhed.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Wedding
programme.desc: Dangle preps for his wedding after his ex-wife's ex-husband proposes, and Wiegel goes into labor while stuck in cake.

programme.title: South Park: Sådan spiser du med røven
programme.desc: Cartman er omsider gået over stregen, da en spøg, der handler om Kennys kinder, resulterer i, at han ikke kan grine af noget andet.

programme.title: Another Period: Lillian is Dead
programme.desc: Hortense og Bertrams lykke er kortvarig, ligesom Commodore og Chairs. Beatrice tyr til religion, da hendes barslagsmål med Lillian får dødelige konsekvenser, og Blanche føder.

programme.title: South Park: Det er jul i Canada
programme.desc: Kyles adoptivbror Ike bringes tilbage til Canada af sine biologiske forældre, da den nye canadiske statsminister bestemmer, at alle adoptivbørn fra Canada skal sendes hjem.

programme.title: Workaholics: Montez' Wife
programme.desc: Da Montez får mistanke om, at hans kone er utro, hjælper fyrene ham med at finde den skyldige.

programme.title: Workaholics: Temp-Tress
programme.desc: Der er en ny lækker vikar hos TelAmericorp. Adam, Anders og Blake har meget svært ved at koncentrere sig i hendes nærvær. Deres selvkontrol bliver sat på prøve.

programme.title: The Roast of Donald Trump
programme.desc: Milliardæren Donald Trump bliver heglet igennem på Comedy Central af Jeffrey Ross, Seth MacFarlane, Gilbert Gottfried, Whitney Cummings, Snoop Dogg, Larry King, Marlee Matlin, Mike 'The Situation' Sorrentino, Lisa Lampanelli og Anthony Jeselnic.

programme.title: Broad City: Make the Space
programme.desc: Ilana opdager en uhyggelig hemmelighed om Jaimé; Abbi forsøger at foretage springet fra sweater-folder til vinduesdesigner i Anthropologie.

programme.title: South Park: Den sidste meehicaner
programme.desc: Da et spil 'grænsekontrol' går galt antænder Butters mexicansk stolthed, men Cartman er ikke villig til at holde op, mens legen stadig er god.

programme.title: South Park: Mere pis
programme.desc: Af vanvare slår Randy verdensrekorden for den 'største bæ'. Bono, den tidligere rekordindehaver, er besluttet på at fastholde kronen. Men han har en mørk hemmelighed, som kan standse ham.

programme.title: South Park: Scooterne
programme.desc: Børnene vil bruge det seneste i transportmidler for at få mere slik til Halloween end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Oprah's Baby Daddy & Jury Duty
programme.desc: Dave gets Oprah pregnant and recalls being a member of the O.J. Simpson trial jury.

programme.title: Workaholics: DeputyDong
programme.desc: Drengene konfronterer en online-gamer, der har terroriseret dem.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Wall
programme.desc: Garcia and Junior help build a wall to keep Mexicans from crossing into America illegally.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle inviterer Butters i stedet for Cartman til sin fødselsdagsfest, så Cartman bilder Butters ind, at en meteor vil ramme jorden og lukker ham inde i et beskyttelsesrum, så han selv kan gå i stedet.

programme.title: Joe Rogan - Rocky Mountain High
programme.desc: Joe Rogan dækker alt fra sine erfaringer fra jagten på Bigfoot til vigtigheden af at opleve vinteren, til hvor umuligt det er at forklare Kim Kardashian for rumvæsner.

programme.title: South Park: Help, My Teenager Hates Me!
programme.desc: Drengene finder ud af, at med glæden ved at spille Airsoft, følger udfordringen at skulle forholde sig til teenagere.

programme.title: Workaholics: Old Man Ders
programme.desc: Ders fejrer sin 25-års fødselsdag. Først føler han sig for gammel til at fejre den, som han plejer. Men så får han fyrene til at opføre sig umodent som teenagere hele dagen.

programme.title: South Park: Pragtsvinet mod Danmark
programme.desc: Pragtsvinet vil ikke længere være præsident.

programme.title: South Park: Den mexicanske glofrø fra det sydlige Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Som en del af skolearbejdet skal børnene finde ud af Vietnam og tror på en latterlig historie, som Stans onkel Jimbo finder på.
programme.sub-title: Den mexicanske glofrø fra det sydlige Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park: Glutenfri ebola
programme.desc: South Park bliver glutenfrit.

programme.title: South Park: Åh, nej
programme.desc: Gerald står ansigt til ansigt med Troll-jægeren.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Burning Man Festival
programme.desc: When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Blackzilla & Playa Haters' Ball
programme.desc: Dave takes Japan by storm in the sci-fi adventure "Blackzilla," and America Undercover presents The Playa Haters' Ball.

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans gamle bedstefar forsøger at narre drengene til at slå ham ihjel. I mellemtiden forsøger South Parks forældre at overtale et tv-netværk til at befri luftrummet for Terrance og Philip.

programme.title: South Park: Seerkrigen
programme.desc: Drengene bliver inddraget i en seerkrig, da deres 'Super School News' er i fare for at blive nedlagt, og de vil bruge alle midler for at tiltrække seere.

programme.title: South Park: Korns seje piratspøgelsemysterium
programme.desc: Drengene plages af dem fra 5.klasse, og South Park bliver løbet over ende af piratspøgelser i denne uhyggelige Halloween-episode.

programme.title: RENO 911!: British Law
programme.desc: Inspector Martin Smiley of the U.K. joins the Reno Sheriff's Department in an exchange program.

programme.title: Anthony Jeselnik - Caligula DA
programme.desc: Anthony Jeselnik er alles yndlingsprins af mørk komedie, og han gør omsider sit entimes stand-up special tilgængeligt for den brede offentlighed.

programme.title: South Park: Følg det æg!
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at forhindre Mr. Slave i at gifte sig med Big Gay Al, prøver Ms. Garrison at få børnenes hjælp til et eksperiment, der skal bevise, at homofile ægteskaber ikke fungerer.

programme.title: South Park: City People
programme.desc: Cartman bliver ikke glad, da hans mor får nyt job.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemi-special
programme.desc: Randy må erkende sin rolle i covid-19-udbruddet, da pandemien fortsætter med at skabe problemer i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Tis
programme.desc: Høje urintal i svømmepølen fører til en katastrofe, der ødelægger drengenes dag, særligt Kyles. Og Cartmans xenofobi får frit udløb igen.

programme.title: South Park: Infårtion
programme.desc: Mens han er til en gruppeterapitime mod hamstring, bliver Stan fanget i en drøm om skolerådgiveren mr. Mackey.

programme.title: South Park: Heksesønner
programme.desc: Til den årlige halloween-fest kaster en heks en besværgelse, der terroriserer alle i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Babser og drager
programme.desc: Dørene til centeret åbner til det første 'Black Friday'-udsalg i historien. Drengene er uenige om hvilket spiludstyr de skal købe, så et blodig slag skal afgøre om Xbox eller Sony vinder.

programme.title: South Park: De bedste venner i verden
programme.desc: Cartman bliver jaloux, da Kenny får den sidste bærbare spilkonsol, før legetøjsforretningen løber tør. Vil Cartman og Kenny forblive bedste venner for evigt?

programme.title: South Park: Den mexicanske joker
programme.desc: Randy kæmper mod hjemmedyrket. Kyle skal på lejr.

programme.title: South Park: Slutningen på serien som vi kender den
programme.desc: Det går endelig op for Cartman, hvorfor Heidi vil have, at de rejser til Mars.
programme.sub-title: Slutningen på serien som vi kender den

programme.title: South Park: Noget du kan gøre med dine fingre
programme.desc: 'Fingerbang' er det sidste nye band, som de fire drenge optræder i, og det lykkedes dem at komme til at spille i det lokale shoppingcenter.
programme.sub-title: Noget du kan gøre med dine fingre

programme.title: South Park: Hvide mennesker sætter huse i stand
programme.desc: Randy forholder sig til, hvad det indebærer at være hvid i dagens samfund.
programme.sub-title: Hvide mennesker sætter huse i stand

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion rejser sig
programme.desc: Ført an af 'Mysterion', arbejder 'Coon' og hans venner med at hjælpe folk i Golfen. Og 'Coon' er ude efter hævn.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman bliver lykkelig over at opdage, at han kan sige, hvad han vil til hvem han vil ved at forgive at have Tourettes. Det landsdækkende tv dukker naturligvis op.

programme.title: South Park: Lad dem spise klisterstads
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om, at den nye plantebaserede menu på skolen har givet ham et hjerteanfald.

programme.title: South Park: Pragtsvinet mod Danmark
programme.desc: Pragtsvinet vil ikke længere være præsident.

programme.title: South Park: Sexchikane-panda
programme.desc: Cartman sagsøger Stan for seksuel chikane.

programme.title: South Park: W.T.F.
programme.desc: Efter at have set deres første live WWE wrestling-kamp beslutter drengene at danne deres eget wrestlingforbund og får en stor fanskare af rednecks!

programme.title: South Park: Goobacks
programme.desc: South Park er invaderet af arbejdere fra fremtiden, som tager alle job for en lavere betaling. Mændene i South Park griber til usædvanlige midler for at standse dem.

programme.title: South Park: Tolerancens dødskamp
programme.desc: Mr. Garrison vender tilbage til lærergerningen for at erstatte Mr. Hat, og drengene bliver sendt til Tolerancens Dødskamp.

programme.title: South Park: En dreng og en præst
programme.desc: Et meget specielt forhold udvikler sig mellem Butters og den lokale præst. Da byens indbyggere kommer hen til en lukket kirke, og de to venner er forsvundet, tilkalder de den katolske kirke.

programme.title: South Park: Uopfyldt
programme.desc: South Park bliver valgt til at huse Amazons nyeste logistikcenter.

programme.title: South Park: Danser med smølfer
programme.desc: Cartmans får endelig et sted, hvor han kan komme af med sin galde, da han bliver udnævnt til oplæser på skolen, og han udnytter selvfølgelig situationen.

programme.title: South Park: Giv slip, regering
programme.desc: Cartman infiltrerer NSA for at afsløre dem og bliver ikke glad for at se, hvad han finder i sin egen mappe.

programme.title: South Park: Grå daggry
programme.desc: De ældre indbyggere bliver tvunget til at indlevere deres kørekort efter at have forårsaget kaos i gaderne. Stans bedstefar tilkalder AARP for at hjælpe pensionisterne.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 2
programme.desc: Regeringen holder Stan og Kyle i fangenskab og vil ikke frigive dem, før de afslører, hvordan de kom ind i Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Obama vinder!
programme.desc: Eric Cartman gemmer noget på sit værelse, der kan ændre udfaldet af præsidentvalget.

programme.title: South Park: Mit fremtidige mig
programme.desc: En 32-årig mand ankommer til South Park og påstår, at han er Stan fra fremtiden, og Cartman går ind i hævnbranchen.

programme.title: South Park: Verdensomspændende blokfløjtekoncert
programme.desc: Klassen skal opføre en blokfløjtekoncert i Mr. Garrisons hjemby i Arkansas, hvor de forsøger at finde 'den brune lyd'.

programme.title: South Park: Du Yelper ikke
programme.desc: Cartman mener, at han er den bedste online-restaurantanmelder i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Hummel-figurer & heroin
programme.desc: Elskede entertainere dør i deres bedste levetid på grund af overdoser. Stan er ved at blive afsløret som kilden til de ulovlige stoffer.

programme.title: South Park: Gratis hat
programme.desc: Drengene tager en sag til sig, da de indser, at deres yndlingsfilm bliver forbedret, genudgivet og ødelagt i processen.

programme.title: South Park: Forkrøblet sommer
programme.desc: Jimmy er på lejr med sine handikappede venner, og det går ikke op for ham, at Nathan prøver at myrde ham. Drengene arrangerer en intervention, når Towelies stofmisbrug bliver for meget.

programme.title: South Park: Kun for medlemmer
programme.desc: Den nyvalgte præsident besøger sin hjemby.

programme.title: South Park: Læg den væk
programme.desc: Nordkorea har South Park i sigtekornet.

programme.title: South Park: Bebes bryster ødelægger samfundet
programme.desc: Bebe er den første pige i fjerde, der 'udvikler sig', hvilket truer drengenes venskab og samfundet generelt.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Jet

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Great Divide
programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across.

programme.desc: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blue Spirit
programme.desc: After Sokka and Katara get sick due to being in the storm, Aang seeks out a cure and discovers he needs some frozen frogs in order to get them cured.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Fortuneteller
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives - but they are so reliant that they are blind to the immanent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bato of the Water Tribe
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Deserter
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Northern Air Temple
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Master
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 1
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao's Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn't a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 1

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 2
programme.desc: Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 2

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar State
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful "Avatar State" as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation. But getting into the "Avatar state" on purpose is more difficult than Aang thinks.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Cave of Two Lovers
programme.desc: On their way to Omashu, the kids meet a group of nomads who show them a short cut through the 'cave of two lovers'.

programme.desc: The kids return to Omashu so that Aang can learn Earthbending from King Bumi. But when they get there, they are shocked to find the city is now in Fire Nation hands. Despite the danger, Aang enters Omashu in search of King Bumi.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Swamp
programme.desc: When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being "connected to the Earth" from an unlikely teacher.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Avatar Day
programme.desc: Aang must clear up a wave of anti-Avatar sentiment and atone for something he did in the past.

programme.desc: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament where they encounter Toph, a blind, but powerful Earthbender.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Zuko Alone
programme.desc: Traveling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bitter Work
programme.desc: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher. Meanwhile, Sokka gets himself in a jam.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Library
programme.desc: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Desert
programme.desc: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Uncle and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Serpent's Pass
programme.desc: The group then huddles around the map to discuss in which direction they should go - the Serpent's Pass appears to be the most direct route.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
programme.desc: Aang discovers a secret Fire Nation super weapon heading straight for Ba Sing Se and must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them. Meanwhile, Jet tries to find proof that Zuko and Uncle are Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Tales of Ba Sing Se

programme.desc: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen, and find out exactly what happened to him, and where's he's been all this time - and where he is now!

programme.desc: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.
